history: A prank shot. The drinker is not usually told what happens next.
whyItWorks: Lime acid curdles the cream on contact with saliva, producing a texture the name describes accurately.
steps: Pour the Irish cream into a shot glass.
Add the lime juice but do not stir.
Instruct the drinker to hold it in the mouth and swirl before swallowing.
techniqueNotes: Genuinely unpleasant. Serve it to someone who has agreed to it.
name: Cement Mixer
description: Irish cream and lime juice, curdled in the mouth on purpose.
